turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We have to pick a moving day and every option has a catch.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait until I've listed everything before you jump in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We could go on the last Friday of the month, cheapest van hire, but it's also the busiest day for everyone moving.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a Tuesday in the middle of the month, quiet roads, but we'd have to pay double rent for two weeks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or the bank holiday weekend, both of us are off work, but the removal company charges extra.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all. Which sounds best to you?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: I'd avoid the last Friday, it's when everything goes wrong at once. Between the Tuesday and the bank holiday, compare the double rent with the holiday surcharge and pick the cheaper.
